items.description: The boundary layer (app/routes/) does not import the database session object
The service layer (app/services/) contains no ORM imports
The boundary layer (app/routes/) contains no ORM imports
Database connection configuration is read exclusively from environment variables
Downgrading then upgrading the stock_records migration recreates the table with all columns and constraints present in the real branch database
Inserting a row with a NULL sku, location, or quantity into stock_records raises a NOT NULL constraint violation in the real branch database
Inserting two rows with the same (sku, location) into stock_records raises a unique constraint violation in the real branch database
Inserting a row with a negative quantity into stock_records raises a CHECK constraint violation in the real branch database
POST a valid new (SKU, location) pair with quantity and tracking code returns success and the record can be read back with exactly those values
POST a payload missing the SKU field returns an HTTP error whose response body names the SKU field
POST a payload with a blank tracking code field returns an HTTP error whose response body names the tracking code field
The service layer rejects a negative quantity write before it reaches the repository
POST a second filing for an existing (SKU, location) pair with a different quantity returns success and the record's quantity reflects the new value
After a second filing for an existing (SKU, location) pair, exactly one record exists for that pair in the store
POST a filing with a negative quantity is rejected with a response message that names the quantity field
POST a filing with a negative quantity leaves no record created or changed in the store
given one or more stock records seeded with unique per-run keys, GET /stock returns one JSON object per seeded record carrying sku, location, and quantity fields
navigating to the home route in <App> via MemoryRouter renders a stock-table row for each record returned by the API
the stock table component renders exactly one row per stock record with SKU, location, and quantity cells visible
quantity cells in the stock table carry the design-guide stock-table class seam that applies right-alignment and tabular-nums
given no stock records exist, GET /stock returns an empty JSON array
navigating to the home route in <App> via MemoryRouter with no stock records renders the element with data-testid='empty-state'
the empty-state element displays the text 'No stock at this location' when the stock list is empty
given a SKU stocked at two locations seeded with unique per-run keys, GET /stock/<sku> returns exactly one JSON object per location, each carrying that location and its quantity for the SKU
given a stock record seeded with a unique per-run key and a non-empty combined tracking code, GET /stock/<sku> returns that record with the combined tracking code field matching the seeded value
given a stock record seeded with a unique per-run key and no par level set, GET /stock/<sku> returns that record with the par-level field absent or null

The boundary route for the SKU detail endpoint returns the par_level field as null or absent when the stock record has no par level — it does not synthesize or inject a 'not tracked' (or equivalent) presentation string into the JSON response
navigating to the SKU detail route via <App> in MemoryRouter renders the SkuDetailPage at that path
when a SKU has stock at multiple locations, the detail page renders one element carrying data-testid='location-row' per location
each rendered location row contains the visible location NAME text for that location
each rendered location row contains the visible quantity NUMBER for that location (a row with an empty data-testid and no quantity text fails)
each location row carries its design-guide class (asserted via className or data-testid seam, never an inline style attribute)
navigating to the SKU detail route via <App> in MemoryRouter renders the combined tracking code for a location that carries one
the tracking code element carries its design-guide data-testid seam (not an inline style)
navigating to the SKU detail route via <App> in MemoryRouter when the SKU's par level is null/omitted renders an explicit 'not tracked' indicator (not blank, not a crash)
the 'not tracked' par-level indicator carries its design-guide data-testid seam (never an inline style or null rendered as empty string)
